historical_references.reference: Monaj was a prince in the Nanda Empire (342 BCE - 321 BCE) in Magadha, India. He was a contemporary of Alexander the Great and is mentioned in the Greek historian Ctesias' Indica.
Monaj is also mentioned in the Jain texts as a patron of Jain scholars and a devotee of Mahavira. He is believed to have ruled around the 5th century BCE.
